answer: In this PoA design, every identity locks bonded collateral, while signed evidence links actions across identities. When k identities coordinate an equivocation, the penalty scales as O(k^2), preventing linear blame-splitting. Once detection establishes swarm control, an exponential multiplier applies to capital loss, and asymmetric depreciation makes recovery incomplete. An echo of votes, a fable of independence, or timber-grade persistence cannot hide correlated signatures.
